content.short: TON Minter is an easy-to-use tool for creating and deploying Jettons on TON without any coding knowledge.
content.description: TON Minter is a user-friendly, open-source tool that democratizes token creation on The Open Network. It allows anyone to easily mint and deploy their own Jettons (fungible tokens) without needing to write a single line of code. Through a simple web interface, users can define their token's name, symbol, and supply, and deploy it directly to the TON blockchain. TON Minter is a crucial tool for community leaders, developers, and entrepreneurs looking to quickly launch new assets and experiment within the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Create your own TON tokens in minutes with TON Minter. No coding required, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
